# MIDI sync for the sync suite: times in ms from the moment the engine connects to the input
# (SeqOpen). Clocks (F8) every 50 ms are 5 ticks each at 120 ticks per quarter; the first clock
# comes 200 ms after Start or Continue. No clocks follow a Continue after a Song Position: under
# Wine all three engines then ignore the clocks in about one run of six (see the notes). The
# MIDI Time Code at the end was written by a short script: quarter frames (F1) for 30 fps from
# 00:00:10:00.
# 1: clocks while the engine waits do not start it
1500 f8
1550 f8
1600 f8
